Here are two strong value-for-money picks from our range, based just on the info we have:
Big Mouth Chilly’s Bottle (2L/4L)
Best for: Maximum capacity and extreme performance.
Key value points:
Huge sizes (2L & 4L) so you refill far less.
Keeps drinks cold up to 72 hours and hot up to 48 hours – triple the usual cold performance.
100% leak-proof, even with fizzy drinks.
Versatile: handles water, hot coffee, fizzy and alcoholic drinks (just not organic stuff like milk/juice).
Practical extras: ergonomic handle stress‑tested to 15kg, silent base ring, antimicrobial pouring collar for clean, drip‑free pours.
Why it’s good value: You’re getting festival / office / gym / group-sized hydration plus top‑tier insulation in one bottle, so it can replace buying multiple smaller bottles or coolers.
Series 3 Water Bottle (350ml, 500ml, 1L)
Best for: Everyday carry with sustainable materials.
Available in three sizes (350ml, 500ml, 1L) to match daily use.
Keeps drinks cold for 36–60 hours (and Series 3 Flip 45–75 hours).
100% leak‑proof with o‑ring seal.
Made from 90% recycled stainless steel (body & lid) and fully BPA‑free.
Antimicrobial technology on drinking surfaces and silicone parts, reducing microbes by up to 99.99%.
Elevated rubber base for stability and quieter put‑downs, with an updated lid thread that opens smoothly.
Why it’s good value: You get strong insulation, sustainable materials, and daily‑use comfort features in a more compact, hand‑washable bottle that suits commuting, work, and general on‑the‑go use.
Quick comparison
Capacity & use: Big Mouth is a “go big” solution (2–4L) ideal for sharing or very long days; Series 3 is a classic personal bottle (350ml–1L).
Cold performance: Big Mouth: up to 72 hours; Series 3: up to 36–60 hours.
Hot performance: Big Mouth explicitly up to 48 hours; Series 3 hot performance isn’t specified, but it’s designed for strong insulation.
Portability: Series 3 is easier to carry daily; Big Mouth shines at festivals, gyms, beaches, and offices as a hydration hub.
So, if you want maximum performance and capacity per bottle, Big Mouth is the top value. If you want sustainable, everyday practicality with strong insulation, the Series 3 Bottle gives excellent value for regular use.
